notes.title: Lost Recall is on sale
notes.notes: Do you want to take on a challenge? Face logical puzzles using various types of robots!

notes.title: Lost Recall has just been released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639782/54fc4debd0e83ad78bfa8a267473db92efc10290.png[/img]

After several months of work, it's finally here. Lost Recall sets sail and is now available on the Steam platform. Currently supported on the Windows operating system, it offers achievements and is fully compatible with gamepad play. Enjoy the game!
